_note: Remake-authored rival decks (not decoded data), one per rival per difficulty level: rival/x_lvN. Levels 1-2 mostly Normal monsters, 3-4 effects/fusions/rituals, 5 chains and control, 6-7 tuned. Built from each rival's anime decks (Duelist Kingdom -> Battle City), legal under the 2004 list. Card names -> copies.

yugi/x_lv1.idea: EASY - Grandpa's Deck (Duelist Kingdom, early): Normal monsters with equips; Dark Magician and Gaia are the stars, Polymerization makes Gaia the Dragon Champion.

yugi/x_lv2.idea: EASY - Duelist Kingdom: more Dark Magicians and Gaias, Kuriboh and Magician of Faith join, Mirror Force appears.

yugi/x_lv3.idea: NORMAL - Duelist Kingdom finals: the Magnet Warriors, both rituals (Black Luster Soldier, Magician of Black Chaos), Kuriboh + Multiply, Magical Hats.

yugi/x_lv4.idea: NORMAL - Battle City: Dark Magician Girl, Buster Blader, Valkyrion from the Magnet Warriors, Chimera from Gazelle + Berfomet, Dark Magic Curtain and Thousand Knives, chain traps (Magic Jammer, Seven Tools).

yugi/x_lv5.idea: HARD - Battle City finals: Dark Magician engine (Curtain, Charity, Knives, Dark Magic Ritual), recursion (Faith, Reborn, Premature, Call), counters (Jammer, Solemn, Seven Tools).

yugi/x_lv6.idea: EXPERT - Dark Magician control: Dark Magic Curtain and Thousand Knives around three Dark Magicians, Magician of Faith and Premature for recursion, Snatch Steal / Heavy Storm / Torrential / Ring of Destruction and both counter traps.

kaiba/x_lv1.idea: EASY - Duelist Kingdom Kaiba: big Normal beaters (Hitotsu-Me, Saggi, La Jinn, Judge Man), one Blue-Eyes, Battle Ox + Mystic Horseman = Rabid Horseman, Crush Card.

kaiba/x_lv2.idea: EASY - Duelist Kingdom finals: two Blue-Eyes, Lord of D. + Flute, Ancient Lamp / La Jinn, Crush Card.

kaiba/x_lv3.idea: NORMAL - Battle City Kaiba: three Blue-Eyes, Lord of D. + Flute, Vorse Raider, three Thunder Dragons (Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon), Crush Card and Ring of Destruction.

kaiba/x_lv4.idea: NORMAL - Battle City finals: Blue-Eyes and Thunder Dragons with the staples (Charity, Premature, Nobleman, Swords), Witch/Sangan to fetch Lord of D., Call of the Haunted.

kaiba/x_lv5.idea: HARD - Kaiba beatdown: Vorse Raiders and Blue-Eyes backed by Snatch Steal, Heavy Storm, Torrential, Solemn and the full trap line; Jinzo shuts off your traps.

kaiba/x_lv6.idea: EXPERT - Lord of D. + The Flute of Summoning Dragon drops Blue-Eyes straight from the hand; Mystic Tomato and Witch both search Lord of D.; Ultimate Offering and Graceful Charity / Reborn cheat out the rest; Polymerization for Blue-Eyes Ultimate. Ancient Lamp special-summons La Jinn from the hand; beaters (Vorse Raider, La Jinn) and Crush Card keep pressure.

joey/x_lv1.idea: EASY - Duelist Kingdom Joey: warriors and beasts with equips; Flame Manipulator + Masaki = Flame Swordsman, the M-Warriors = Karbonala Warrior, one Red-Eyes.

joey/x_lv2.idea: EASY - Duelist Kingdom finals: two Red-Eyes, Time Wizard + Baby Dragon = Thousand Dragon, Alligator's Sword Dragon, the Battleguards, Graceful Dice and Skull Dice.

joey/x_lv3.idea: NORMAL - Battle City Joey: Gearfried, Panther Warrior + Scapegoat, Rocket Warrior, Legendary Fisherman with Umi, Thousand Dragon, the dice.

joey/x_lv4.idea: NORMAL - Battle City finals: three Red-Eyes with Metalmorph (Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon) and Meteor Black Dragon, Jinzo, Goblin Attack Force, Sword Hunter, Fairy Box and the gamble traps.

joey/x_lv5.idea: HARD - Joey's gamble beatdown: Gearfried, Panther + Scapegoat, Goblin Attack Force, Jinzo, Red-Eyes, dice for the swing turns, a full trap line.

joey/x_lv6.idea: EXPERT - Red-Eyes + Metalmorph into Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon; Time Wizard's coin wipes the board (and with Baby Dragon + Polymerization, Thousand Dragon); Giant Rat fetches the small EARTH pieces; Scapegoat feeds Panther Warrior; warriors with Axe of Despair / Legendary Sword press; Graceful / Skull Dice for Joey's luck.

yugi/x_lv7.idea: EXPERT (top) - Dark Magician engine: Dark Magic Curtain pulls it from the deck, Graceful Charity pitches it so Dark Magician Girl grows and Reborn/Premature/Call bring it back, Thousand Knives needs it on the field, Dark Magic Ritual for Magician of Black Chaos. Summoned Skull and the Elves keep pressure; Big Shield Gardna, Spellbinding Circles and Trap Holes buy the turns.

kaiba/x_lv7.idea: EXPERT (top) - Thunder and Dragons: three Thunder Dragons thin the deck and feed Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon, Blue-Eyes as the finisher, full control backrow (Jammer, Solemn, Torrential).

joey/x_lv7.idea: EXPERT (top) - Joey's warriors: three Gearfried, Panther Warrior on Scapegoat tokens, Goblin Attack Force, Jinzo, equips and the full staple set; Skull Dice and Magic-Arm Shield for the gamble.

jaden/x_starter.idea: STARTER - Jaden's first deck (picked at the start, or won by beating Jaden once): the four original Elemental HEROes and Polymerization into Flame Wingman and Thunder Giant.

jaden/x_lv1.idea: EASY - Slifer Red rookie (GX season 1, early): the four original Elemental HEROes, Polymerization into Flame Wingman and Thunder Giant, Hero Kid swarm.

jaden/x_lv2.idea: EASY - Seven Stars: Wildheart and Bladedge join, Skyscraper and the Blasters back the fusions up.

jaden/x_lv3.idea: NORMAL - Fusion master: Miracle Fusion from the GY, Shining Flare Wingman, Hero Spirit and Call of the Haunted.

jaden/x_lv4.idea: NORMAL - Society of Light: Elemental HERO Neos joins the classic HEROes; Bladedge and Wildheart hit hard, Sakuretsu Armor and Shrink protect them.

jaden/x_lv5.idea: HARD - Neos and the HERO beaters with Miracle Fusion, backed by Snatch Steal, Heavy Storm and a full trap line.

jaden/x_lv6.idea: EXPERT - Supreme King: Evil HEROes by Dark Fusion and Dark Calling, Malicious Edge pressure, Evil Blast.

jaden/x_lv7.idea: EXPERT - Jaden at his best: the strongest HEROes with Miracle Fusion, the era's best monsters (Breaker, D.D. Warrior Lady, Monarchs, Jinzo) and staples.

yugi/x_exodia_insta.idea: EASY variant (level 2) - The Forbidden One: draw into all 5 Exodia pieces (Royal Magical Library, Upstart Goblin, Jar of Greed) behind stall cards (Swords, Messenger of Peace, Waboku, Threatening Roar). Wins on the spot.

yugi/x_exodia_gy.idea: EASY variant (level 1) - Exodia Necross: send the pieces to the Graveyard (Foolish Burial, Magical Merchant, Card Destruction) and summon an Exodia Necross that grows every turn and can't be destroyed while they stay there.

tour/mai.idea: Mai Valentine - Harpie Ladies: Harpie Lady Sisters, Harpie's Pet Dragon, Elegant Egotist, equips and Harpie's Feather Duster.

tour/pegasus.idea: Maximillion Pegasus - Toon World: Toon monsters attack directly while Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes Restrict steal your monsters.

tour/marik.idea: Marik Ishtar - Battle City: Revival Jam, Makyura, Nightmare Wheel and heavy hitters behind lockdown traps.

tour/bakura.idea: Bakura - Dark Necrofear and the Destiny Board: occult fiends that come back and possess your monsters.

tour/ishizu.idea: Ishizu Ishtar - the Millennium Necklace: the Sphinx monsters and Gravekeeper's under Necrovalley.

tour/odion.idea: Odion - the trap master: Embodiment of Apophis and Temple of the Kings guard a wall of traps.

tour/weevil.idea: Weevil Underwood - insects: Insect Queen, Great Moth from the Cocoon, Parasite Paracide and Insect Barrier.

tour/rex.idea: Rex Raptor - dinosaurs: Two-Headed King Rex, Super Conductor Tyranno and Jurassic World, big Normal Summons and raw ATK.

tour/mako.idea: Mako Tsunami - the sea: Umi with Fortress Whale, The Legendary Fisherman and Kairyu-Shin.

tour/keith.idea: Bandit Keith - machines: Barrel Dragon, Slot Machine, Robotic Knight and Limiter Removal.

tour/zane.idea: Zane Truesdale - Cyber Dragons: Power Bond into Cyber End Dragon, Cyber Barrier and Cyber Laser Dragon, Overload Fusion.

tour/chazz.idea: Chazz Princeton - the Ojamas and Armed Dragon: Ojama King, Light and Dark Dragon backups, Armed Dragon LV3 to LV10, VWXYZ.

tour/alexis.idea: Alexis Rhodes - Cyber Girls: Cyber Blader and Etoile Cyber, the Cyber Angel rituals with Machine Angel Ritual.

tour/bastion.idea: Bastion Misawa - the water deck: Hydrogeddon and Oxygeddon into Water Dragon through Bonding - H2O.

tour/syrus.idea: Syrus Truesdale - Roids: Steamroid, Gyroid and Drillroid fused by Vehicroid Connection Zone into Super Vehicroid.

tour/aster.idea: Aster Phoenix - Destiny HEROes: Disk Commander and Diamond Dude for card advantage, Dogma and Plasma to finish.

tour/crowler.idea: Dr. Vellian Crowler - Ancient Gear: Ancient Gear Golem off Ancient Gear Castle and Statue of the Wicked, Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem.

god/x_obelisk.idea: RARE GOD DECK - Obelisk the Tormentor: floaters and walls (Treeborn Frog, Giant Rat, Marshmallon, Cyber Dragon) build 3 Tributes, Double Summon and Soul Exchange speed it up; Obelisk then Tributes 2 more to wipe the opponent's field.

god/x_slifer.idea: RARE GOD DECK - Slifer the Sky Dragon: a full hand is Slifer's ATK. Upstart Goblin, Jar of Greed, Card of Sanctity and Royal Magical Library refill it; Sangan and Witch search Slifer; floaters pay the 3 Tributes.

god/x_ra.idea: RARE GOD DECK - The Winged Dragon of Ra: Tribute for Ra and pay down to 100 LP for the kill, or burn 1000 LP a shot on its destroy effect. Sphere Mode calls Ra from the deck; Immortal Phoenix (discarded by Graceful Charity / Foolish Burial) rises when Ra falls. Dian Keto and Nimble Momonga keep LP up.

god/x_pantheon.idea: RARE GOD DECK - all three Egyptian Gods, one of each (plus Sphere Mode for Ra). Gold Sarcophagus, Sangan and Witch fetch whichever God the board calls for; floaters and Soul Exchange pay the Tributes.
